elements.title: Progress toward our 2030 goal
elements.content: More than 15% recycled content; Over 20% of manufacturing electricity sourced from renewable energy.

elements.title: Packaging
elements.content: 100% fiber-based, due to our work to remove plastic in packaging; 100% recycled or responsibly sourced wood fibers.

elements.title: Supplier Code of Conduct
elements.content: Through the Apple Supplier Code of Conduct, we set strict standards for safeguarding people and the environment in our supply chain.

elements.title: Smarter chemistry
elements.content: Arsenic-free glass; Mercury-free; Brominated flame retardant-free; PVC-free.

elements.title: Longevity
elements.content: We assessed iMac in our Reliability Testing Lab using rigorous testing methods that simulate customers' experiences.

elements.title: Recovery
elements.content: Return your device through Apple Trade In—at a retail store or online—and we'll give it a new life or recycle it for free.

elements.title: iMac uses 100% recycled aluminum in the stand
elements.content: iMac uses 100% recycled aluminum in the stand
